## TemplateEngine.validateTemplate() method

Validates all aspects of a template: block names, scopes, block format, block positioning, and base attributes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateTemplate(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ valid: boolean; errors: Array&lt;{ line: number; message: string; }&gt;; }

An object with a `valid` boolean and a combined `errors` array containing line numbers and descriptive messages for every violation found

## Remarks

This is a convenience method that runs all validators in order:

1. [TemplateEngine.validateNamesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatenamesblock.md) — checks that all tags are known 2. [TemplateEngine.validateScopes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatescopes.md) — checks that all interpolation scopes are known 3. [TemplateEngine.validateFormatBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateformatblock.md) — checks self-closing vs regular tag syntax 4. [TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatepositionsblock.md) — checks structural nesting rules 5. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockBaseAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockbaseattributes.md) — checks `<base>` block attributes 6. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockMessageAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockmessageattributes.md) — checks `<message>` block attributes 7. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockKeyboardAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockkeyboardattributes.md) — checks `<keyboard>` block attributes 8. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockMediaAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockmediaattributes.md) — checks `<media>` block attributes 9. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockDescriptionAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockdescriptionattributes.md) — checks `<description>` block attributes 10. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockScriptAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockscriptattributes.md) — checks `<script>` block attributes 11. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockSwitchAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockswitchattributes.md) — checks `<switch>` block attributes 12. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockCaseAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockcaseattributes.md) — checks `<case>` block attributes 13. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockDefaultAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockdefaultattributes.md) — checks `<default>` block attributes 14. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockMapAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockmapattributes.md) — checks `<map>` block attributes 15. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockDivAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockdivattributes.md) — checks `<div>` block attributes 16. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockImportAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockimportattributes.md) — checks `<import>` block attributes 17. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockSpaceAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockspaceattributes.md) — checks `<space>` block attributes

Errors from all validators are combined into a single result.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateTemplate(`
  <base>
    <message>Hello {{name}}!</message>
  </base>
`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
